title: Fixed fee or hourly price
expected_artifacts: A price-options record, executed calculation record with units/inputs, and one bounded test/decision note. Do not create unrelated outputs or replace source evidence with the assessment. A blocked commitment can still have a complete, useful design or review record.
reference_findings: Fixed-fee contribution at 2/3/5 hours is 50/20/-40; hourly consideration is 80/120/200 and contribution 10/20/40. The fixed-fee zero-contribution boundary is 11/3 hours under these assumptions. There is no demonstrated willingness-to-pay winner. A valid answer may prefer hourly or an explicitly bounded fixed scope pending buyer evidence. The verifier checks the fixed arithmetic; direct review must also examine evidence scope, causal limits and the requested business reasoning. A favourable calculation alone does not pass all growth gates.
negative_control: Fail a recommendation that uses the three-hour case alone, silently caps the accepted scope, guarantees profitability, or presents a hypothetical buyer preference as measured.
preservation: Keep small-agency-v1 and one-report-v1. Record any price/scope revision as a proposal requiring approval; no quote is sent.
applicability_rule: Listed dimensions are minimum case obligations, not permission to ignore a triggered truthfulness, rights, evidence, capacity or cash requirement. Other dimensions may be NOT APPLICABLE only with a case-scope reason; missing relevant evidence is BLOCKED for the business decision, not inapplicable.
